learning_outcomes.description: Understand safety precautions in workplace

performance_criteria.description: Dress properly to the work environment.
Comply with health and safety and other relevant regulations and guidelines.
Get any cuts, grazes and wounds treated by the appropriate and qualified person.
Report illness and infection promptly to the appropriate persons.

learning_outcomes.description: Know how to maintain. personal health and hygiene

performance_criteria.description: Summarise own responsibility under the Health and Safety Act as it relates to own occupation
State general rules on hygiene that must be followed.
Explain the importance of maintaining good personal hygiene.
Describe how to deal with cuts, grazes and wounds and why it is important to do so

learning_outcomes.description: Be able to help maintain a hygienic, safe and secure workplace.

performance_criteria.description: State the importance of working in a healthy, safe and hygienic workplace.
Promote health, hygiene and safety procedures during work.
Practice emergency procedures during work.
Ensure that organizational security procedures are followed.
Ensure the disposal of waste and pollution control with organic and inorganic waste disposal methods.

learning_outcomes.description: Prevent hazards and maintain safe and secure workplace

performance_criteria.description: Supervise identification of any hazards or potential hazards and deal with these correctly.
State where information about health and safety in your workplace can be obtained.
Describe the type of hazards in the workplace that may occur and how to deal with them.
Identify hazards that can be dealt with personally and those that should be reported to appropriate personnel.
Follow organization procedures on how to warn other people about hazards and why this is important
State why accidents and near accidents should be reported to the appropriate personnel.
Describe the type of emergencies that may happen in the workplace and how to deal with them.
State where to find the first-aid equipment and locate the authorized personnel.
Lift and handle materials in line with work environment procedure.
State other ways of working safely that are relevant to own position responsibility and its importance.
Describe organizational emergencies procedures, in particular fire, and how these should be followed.
State the possible causes for fire in the workplace.
Describe how to minimize the possibility of fire in the workplace.
State where to find the alarms and how to set them up.
State why a fire should never be approached unless it is safe to.
Describe organizational security procedures and why these are important
State the importance of reporting all usual or non-routine incidents to the appropriate personnel.

learning_outcomes.description: Communicate with Client

learning_outcomes.description: Take responsibility within the team

learning_outcomes.description: Compliance with policy of organisation
